title: Application Integration Developer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and maintain Python-based API integrations between our HR information system (HRIS) and business systems, including finance, travel, expense management, and recruiting platforms.
  • Build and maintain cloud-native services, web applications, and containerized workloads on Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement automation for system workflows, onboarding/offboarding, access-related processes, and data synchronization.
  • Create and maintain deployment pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.
  • Own integrations through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support; respond to alerts and troubleshoot issues across APIs, Azure services, and data sources within agreed SLAs.
  • Implement safeguards for sensitive employee data, including validation, audit trails, and controls around mass changes.
  • Work with business stakeholders to clarify requirements and maintain technical documentation as part of each change.

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of integration or backend development experience, including hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
  • Practical experience with Azure compute and integration services. Our stack includes Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps, Container Instances, Service Bus, and API Management.
  • Practical Python development skills, including maintaining and debugging existing services and automations.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and Microsoft Graph API, with an understanding of pagination, rate limits, retries, and idempotency.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Terraform for Azure deployments.
  • Good understanding of OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, and managed identities for secure authentication and service-to-service access.
  • Experience designing and working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, etc.).
  • Experience with automated testing and diagnosing production issues through logs, monitoring, and alerts.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience integrating HRIS or other business systems, such as ERP, expense management, or recruiting platforms.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-204, AZ-900, AZ-104).
  • Hands-on experience with Application Insights and Log Analytics.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to critically evaluate their output.

title: Senior Product Manager - Audiobooks Format Foundations
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

What You'll Do

  • Lead product strategy for Spotify’s audiobook experience, shaping how the format becomes more engaging, valuable, and enjoyable for listeners, creators, and the business.
  • Define and evolve the experience across the audiobook journey, from discovery and evaluation through playback, library management, and reading.
  • Partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to translate business strategy and listener needs into product innovation that supports growth.
  • Drive innovation across multimodal experiences, including the intersection of listening and reading.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences at scale.
  • Use data, experimentation, and user insights to make informed product decisions and continuously improve the experience.
  • Build alignment across Core Experience, Audiobooks, Personalization, and other partners to create a cohesive Spotify experience.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, setting direction and scope, creating alignment, and partnering with Engineering on delivery.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with audiobook, ebook, digital reading, or related consumer products.
  • You have a deep understanding of the audiobook or digital reading landscape, including user behavior, publisher ecosystems, and competitive dynamics.
  • You have experience building consumer products for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user experiences.
  • You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that help teams move faster.
  • You know how to balance user needs, technical considerations, and business impact when making product decisions.
  • You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences at scale.
  • You have partnered closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and other disciplines to bring products from strategy through delivery.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making thoughtful trade-offs, and creating clarity across teams.
  • You can influence stakeholders across functions and levels to build alignment and drive meaningful outcomes.
  • You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, including for research, analysis, iteration, and prototyping.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

title: Content Marketing Lead, Insights
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is building the content engine that makes the market see TRM as the authority on crypto crime and financial-crime intelligence. As Content Marketing Lead for Research & Insights, you will turn the work of our Insights team into reports, articles, and campaigns that customers, journalists, and the wider crime-fighting community read, cite, and act on. You will own a proactive plan for which research stories TRM tells, when, and for whom, and make sure each one reaches the right audience.

The impact you will have:

  • Set the research content agenda. Build and own a proactive editorial plan with the Insights team that decides which findings become flagship reports, blog posts, social content, or media pitches, using AI to scan the research pipeline and surface the stories worth telling.

  • Turn research into a content engine. Carry findings from concept to published, distributed content and handle roughly 1 to 3 pieces a week, using AI workflows across review, drafting, and repurposing so quality holds as volume grows.

  • Decide the argument, then let AI accelerate production. Shape and pressure-test each narrative and its data yourself, then use AI to draft variants, headlines, and channel-specific cuts so more of your time goes to judgment and less to production.

  • Own distribution for everything you produce. Plan how each piece reaches its audience before it publishes, push it across owned, paid, and earned channels, and use AI to tailor it for social, the newsletter, and executive voice.

  • Grow TRM's search and AI-citation visibility. Produce the content that makes TRM the cited authority on priority themes, and use SEO and GEO tooling to find gaps and measure what moves.

  • Support media outreach. Work alongside TRM's head of Comms on journalist outreach for research releases, feed what you learn from coverage back into the content plan, and tune what works for the next release.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of B2B content marketing, editorial, or research-communications experience, with a portfolio of data- or research-based point-of-view work.

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI across research review, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, and you build workflows others can reuse.

  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to strengthen complex, technical narratives without sacrificing accuracy, including when AI produced the first draft.

  • Experience owning a piece end to end, from concept through publication and distribution, and proactively planning content rather than only fulfilling requests.

  • A distribution mindset, with comfort using AI and analytics to measure and improve how content performs.

  • The ability to translate technical, data-driven material into clear, engaging content, using AI to adapt tone and format for different audiences.

About the Team:

  • You will join Content & Brand Marketing within GTM Marketing, working hand in hand with the Insights team in Primary Intelligence and with Demand Gen and Comms.

  • The work is dedicated to data and research-based storytelling: TRM's credibility depends on the market seeing our intelligence and domain expertise, and this role scales that output.

  • It is a small, senior, AI-native team that expects ownership, pace, and strong judgment, and gives you real latitude to decide what TRM should be known for.

  • The hard part is intellectual: challenging researchers, finding the angle that makes a finding matter, and keeping quality high as volume grows.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across the US and Europe/UK and keeps collaboration-hours overlap so ideas move quickly.

  • Async-first communication with regular syncs; the editorial calendar is the team's shared source of truth.

  • Close, continuous partnership with researchers, Demand Gen, and Comms rather than handoffs.

  • AI is part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Overlap with US-based team collaboration hours; specific hours confirmed at offer.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or event travel.

  • Frequency: Occasional.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: None; fully remote.

  • Frequency: None.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • In your first 30 days, publish a research piece end to end, from concept to distribution, with a plan for how it reaches its audience.

  • Within 60 days, stand up an AI-assisted production workflow that lets the team ship 1 to 3 research pieces a week without adding headcount.

  • Within 90 days, move a flagship finding from idea to press-ready and placed, measurably lifting reach and search or AI-citation visibility on a priority theme.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000-$188,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

description:

TRM is hiring a VP of Global Growth to lead our next stage of expansion, building a global growth organization that delivers repeatable, scalable, and efficient growth.

You will own global pipeline generation across the company and the customer journey from initial awareness through to a sales-accepted opportunity. You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, be a key member of our Growth Leadership Team, and lead teams across growth strategy, digital and lifecycle marketing, account-based marketing, field marketing, and marketing operations and analytics. You will establish attribution, experimentation, and funnel visibility to understand what’s working, address what isn’t, and guide TRM on where to invest to drive growth.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the pipeline generation plan. Translate revenue targets into pipeline requirements by market, region, offering, and customer type. Account for conversion rates and sales cycles, agree contributions with other revenue leaders, and own the consolidated plan and response to gaps.

  • Find and attack the bottlenecks. Map how accounts and buyers move from awareness to qualified opportunities, define the entry and exit criteria for each stage, and identify where progress stalls. Work with Sales to improve handoffs and use win/loss results to sharpen targeting and programs.

  • Lead the full demand generation engine. Integrate demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle, account-based marketing (ABM), field marketing, and digital into a coordinated strategy that generates qualified pipeline across global pods. Connect events, executive programs, content, and coordinated sales outreach to explicit pipeline goals.

  • Build digital and lifecycle capabilities. Lead paid search and social, organic search and AI discovery, website conversion, landing pages, nurture, and reactivation. Understand how these channels work together and where additional investment can generate qualified pipeline efficiently.

  • Increase experimentation velocity. Diagnose where the growth engine underperforms, prioritize high-impact hypotheses, and establish a fast, disciplined cadence of experiments across audiences, channels, campaigns, and conversion paths. Use AI to accelerate targeting, campaign operations, content production, and analysis while maintaining quality.

  • Build a stunning team and culture. Develop the existing team, recruit critical talent, and set clear responsibilities across shared capabilities and market teams. Own the budget and agency relationships, establish a disciplined operating rhythm, and use AI and automation to increase the team’s capacity and speed.

  • Executive leadership: Serve as the executive voice for pipeline generation, advising the CRO, CEO, and broader leadership team on pipeline performance, investment tradeoffs, and opportunities across markets and customer segments.

What we’re looking for:

  • A track record of owning and growing qualified pipeline in an enterprise technology business with complex buying groups and long sales cycles. You can explain the targets, investment decisions, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes behind your results.

  • Quantitative fluency and sound judgment with imperfect data. You can build a funnel model, pressure-test attribution, evaluate acquisition economics, and design useful experiments when volumes are too small for simple A/B tests.

  • A track record driving both new-logo acquisition and customer expansion, with a rigorous understanding of conversion, acquisition economics, and payback.

  • Deep full-funnel expertise, from awareness and MQL generation through opportunity creation, Sales handoffs, and downstream pipeline outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success building multitouch attribution, marketing analytics, and forecasting models that improve investment decisions and reveal where the funnel is underperforming.

  • A disciplined approach to experimentation, with evidence of increasing testing velocity and translating learning into measurable improvements in qualified pipeline and conversion.

  • Experience leading demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle, ABM, digital, and regional or field marketing, supported by strong marketing operations and data analytics.

  • Applied AI fluency: you can show how you have used AI to improve campaign operations, targeting, content velocity, forecasting, or attribution, with appropriate quality controls.

  • A track record hiring and developing leaders and building an operating model that creates accountability across teams and functions.

  • Multi-region experience across NA, APAC, and EMEA, ideally including public-sector or regulated-buyer motions, with the judgment to tailor strategy by market and segment.

  • Strong executive communication and GTM partnership. You can align leaders on the growth plan, challenge assumptions with evidence, and move comfortably between revenue outcomes and campaign detail.

This role may be a fit if you…

  • Have willed extraordinarily ambitious programs and teams into existence

  • Look at a funnel and immediately hypothesize about bottlenecks and experiments to run

  • Are as energized by developing a market strategy as you are by building a campaign, rewriting a landing page, or fixing a broken handoff

  • Experiment constantly with AI and find yourself teaching others how to uplevel their usage

  • Need to be at a company where you can draw a straight line from the work you do to a positive impact in your community

title: Account Manager - Speech & AI Technologies
description:
About Side

Side is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 15+ studios in over a dozen countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. We're seeking an Account Manager who will lead high-profile relationships within the speech and AI ecosystem. This role combines technical fluency, partnership management, legal and commercial awareness. The successful candidate will act as a trusted interface between client technical teams and internal delivery teams, ensuring alignment, solution clarity, and long-term partnership stability.

This is not a pure sales role. It requires strong technical credibility and a customer-first mindset.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary relationship lead for a major enterprise technology partner within the speech and AI domain.
  • Engage directly with client stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML, Data Science, and Speech teams.
  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear internal delivery plans and execution roadmaps.
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and operational capabilities across data, engineering, and production teams.

title: Teacher of Personal Social Health & Citizenship Education
description:
We are looking for a passionate person who is ambitious for our students and community and will support our inclusive ethos.

Applications are sought from high calibre professionals who have the skills and talent to continue to develop the department and work as part of our committed team.

Holmer Green is a popular 11 to 18 school with 1250 students (200+ in the Sixth Form) and is expanding. The school has a range of newly built modern facilities which now includes a purpose-built English and Maths block, new cafeteria and fitness suite.

We can offer 8 staff training days (not the 5 you find in most schools), a two-week October half term and professional development of a high standard. We take our staff well-being seriously and offer weekly activities, like team sports, free use of a fitness suite, a Staff Forum, access to Employee Assistance Programme, car parking, paid lunch duties plus free lunch

Duties and Responsibilities

To be committed to the safeguarding and well-being of all students and to follow school Policy and procedures in this regard.

The major task of teachers is to enable all students to achieve their full potential (social, physical, emotional and intellectual) by developing in them relevant skills, competencies, attitudes, concepts and knowledge. Teachers should use their professional judgements and skills to help students to acquire the confidence to tackle all aspects of learning throughout their lives. They should seek to enhance self-esteem and self-fulfilment of students through a supportive, encouraging, yet challenging approach to learning.

Teachers will achieve these aims by working at or towards the professional standards at the appropriate level. All teachers will be expected to prepare, teach, mark work and keep appropriate records of assessment of designated groups within Team or Departmental areas in accordance with school and department policies. A wide variety of teaching styles suited to the needs of individuals and small groups as well as whole classes should be adopted.

All teachers will be expected to work collaboratively with other staff as members of teams, departments and/or other cross-curricular groups. They will contribute their own particular talents and skills to such groups to aid the production of new initiatives, policies, resources, schemes of work etc.

In collaboration with students and support staff, all teachers are responsible for caring for the School environment, and teachers take responsibility for their own rooms.

Teachers should have a concern for the academic and general welfare of students in their care during specific lessons, but teachers who are tutors (and most are) are expected to take a broader responsibility for the development and progression of a group of students.

Much is expected of teachers at Holmer Green Senior School in order to meet both their own professional fulfilment and the aims of the School, but all staff also have the right to appropriate support, learning and development opportunities and INSET through formal and informal contact with colleagues, particularly Heads of Department, and members of the Leadership Team.

Teachers are encouraged to assist in the development of any aspects of the school to which they feel drawn.

Qualifications Required

Good honours degree or equivalent

Qualified Teacher Status

Evidence of recent or relevant training and development and/or further study

Holmer Green Senior School is committed to the welfare and safeguarding of all its students and therefore all appointments are made subject to satisfactory Enhanced DBS, qualification and pre-employment checks

We will carry out an online search (including social media) as part of our due diligence on the shortlisted candidates. This may help identify any incidents or issues that have happened, and are publicly available online, which the school might want to explore with the applicant at interview. Shortlisted candidates will also be asked to complete a safer recruitment self-declaration form before interview


The school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date should a suitable candidate become available

title: Software Engineer (Go)
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

As a Software Engineer within our Billing group, you will play a key role in developing core areas of our new billing platform. You’ll provide world-class experiences to thousands of customers who use and trust Paddle every day. You'll take the lead on discovering new features, planning their implementation, and contributing your technical expertise to shape the future of our billing platform.

You’ll collaborate with multiple teams—engineers, product managers, and designers—working across a wide range of areas that will give you plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career as a valued member of our engineering team.

What you'll do:

  • Independently deliver on milestones that may span across multiple systems within Billing.

  • Make changes with care and precision, recognising the importance of correctness when working with financial data.

  • Contribute to systems designed for scale, reliability, and security, following established architectural patterns.

  • Write clear, well-structured, and well-tested code that meets team standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

  • Break down larger pieces of work into manageable tasks and estimate your own work with guidance.

  • Help monitor and support production services, investigating and fixing issues as they arise.

  • Contribute to shaping our team and wider engineering culture to ensure Paddle remains an exceptional place to work.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data, Risk, and Operations to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Help shape product direction by providing technical insights, trade-offs, and delivery estimates.

  • Partner with Customer Support or Operations teams to investigate and resolve production issues.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have a development background with Go.

  • Have experience designing and building systems to handle high traffic at scale in a cloud-based environment in AWS

  • Are someone who enjoys collaborating with our technical and non-technical departments

  • Have a proactive attitude towards finding ways to improve the code and team processes.

  • A strong understanding of the development process - from design through to deployment, maintenance, and what that means for day-to-day development.

  • A strong understanding of API principles and best practices.

  • A proven track record of bias for action and strong customer focus.

  • Solid communication and collaboration skills, you should be comfortable working alongside both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Are someone who takes pride in what you build.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Channel Account Manager
description:
About Cobalt

At Cobalt, we believe everyone deserves to live and work in a safer, more secure world. Founded in 2013 on the belief that penetration testing could – and should – be better, we set out to challenge the status quo and transform how organizations approach offensive security.

Today, we’re leading the way in transforming the offensive security market, bringing together world-class security expertise, innovative technology and a global community of security professionals to make security testing more seamless, effective and collaborative. Our diverse, fully-remote team partners with organizations of all sizes to help them OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

And we’re just getting started!

AI is fundamentally reshaping the cybersecurity landscape, creating new opportunities, new challenges and entirely new ways of thinking about security. At Cobalt, we’re not waiting to see what happens next; we’re helping define it. We’re challenging conventions, pushing boundaries and reimagining what’s possible in offensive security.

Customers can launch a pentest in as little as 24 hours through our SaaS platform and exclusive Cobalt Core community. With 500+ highly vetted security testers, representing just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core conducts thousands of tests annually, helping organizations identify and remediate risk across their evolving attack surfaces.

This is an exciting time to join Cobalt. We’re looking for ambitious, creative and agile leaders who thrive on change, think beyond traditional playbooks and have the vision to create new categories, shape markets and build what comes next. If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a real impact in a market undergoing significant transformation, we’d love you to be part of our journey.

Description

Cobalt is looking for a Channel Account Manager to develop, manage, and grow our technology and strategic partner ecosystem across the UK. This role will be responsible for building strong relationships with existing partners, identifying and recruiting new strategic partners, and driving joint go-to-market initiatives that generate pipeline and revenue for Cobalt.

You will manage a diverse portfolio of partners, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security and IT consulting firms, and strategic alliance partners. Working closely with partners and internal teams, you will develop joint business plans, strengthen sales and marketing alignment, enable partner teams, and create opportunities to expand Cobalt's market presence.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for someone who can balance strategic relationship management with day-to-day execution. You will own partner engagement and performance across your territory, driving measurable outcomes through partner-sourced pipeline, joint selling initiatives, and revenue growth.

What You Would Do

  • Partner Relationship Management: Own and grow relationships with strategic Cobalt partners across the UK, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security software companies, and IT consulting firms.
  • Partner Recruitment & Development: Identify, engage, and develop new partner relationships while expanding the engagement and contribution of existing partners.
  • Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute partner business plans, go-to-market strategies, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) focused on generating pipeline, increasing partner engagement, and driving shared revenue.
  • Partner Enablement: Train and enable partner sales and technical teams to effectively position Cobalt's Pentest as a Service platform, communicate its value proposition, and identify opportunities within their customer base.
  • Joint Go-to-Market Execution: Build and execute collaborative marketing and sales initiatives, including co-branded content, campaigns, webinars, events, account mapping, lead-sharing programs, and joint customer engagements.
  • Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities through joint prospecting, referrals, co-selling, and reseller activities. Own partner pipeline reporting, forecasting, and progress against revenue targets.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Cobalt's Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to align partner priorities, support joint selling activities, and identify opportunities for deeper solution alignment and market expansion.
  • Partner Operations & Performance: Establish and maintain effective partner engagement processes, including pipeline governance, reporting, lead management, enablement resources, and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Market Development: Identify opportunities to expand Cobalt's presence across EMEA technology and cybersecurity ecosystem through strategic partnerships, industry relationships, and joint market initiatives.

You Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in channel management or partner management within B2B SaaS or cybersecurity (preferrably).
  • Experience managing, developing, or supporting relationships with technology partners, solution integrators, resellers, OEMs, or strategic alliances.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategies, channel sales motions, and partner-led revenue generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, develop joint business plans, and drive measurable business outcomes through partners.
  • Experience developing and executing partner-facing marketing and sales initiatives, including joint campaigns, co-branded content, webinars, events, and account mapping.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Experience managing partner pipelines, tracking performance, and providing accurate reporting and forecasts.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple partner relationships and initiatives while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a quota-carrying role, with direct responsibility for pipeline generation or revenue targets.
  • Existing relationships within the UK and wider Europe cybersecurity, IT services, and technology partner ecosystem.
  • Experience selling or partnering within cybersecurity, penetration testing, or security services.
  • Familiarity with selling into IT and security leadership, including CISOs, CTOs, and other senior technology stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating partner agreements and managing complex partner or alliance relationships.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, PartnerStack, and other CRM or partner management platforms.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a scaling SaaS organization.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Shape the Future of Cybersecurity: Help define the Continuous Offensive Security Market, build Cobalt's global brand and establish category leadership in a rapidly growing industry.
  • Make a Strategic Impact: Work alongside an experienced executive team, influence company strategy and lead a global marketing organization through Cobalt's next phase of growth.
  • Share in Our Success: Enjoy competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan, with the opportunity to share in the long-term value you help create.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Access retirement savings 401(k) in the US or pension in the EU, healthcare coverage and dedicated stipends for wellness, home office equipment, Wi-Fi and learning and development.
  • Work Flexibly, Live Fully: Benefit from generous flexible paid time off and 12 weeks of paid parental leave, supporting your wellbeing and life beyond work.

title: 3PL Operations Manager
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Europe 3PL operations manager

Position Overview

The European 3PL Manager owns Nebius's network of external warehouses and the performance of the 3PL partners who run them. The role ensures that high-value data center hardware stored and handled by third parties is received, stored, picked and shipped to the same standard as in Nebius-operated sites.

The manager controls 3PL operations through SLAs, KPIs, audits and system data, coordinates daily flows between 3PLs and internal teams (Transport, Planning, Back Office, ITDC, Security), and drives cost, compliance and continuous improvement across all external locations.

Key Responsibilities

  1. 3PL Network & Partner Management
  • Manage the portfolio of external warehouses and 3PL partners across EMEA/US/APAC.
  • Own contracts, SLAs and rate cards together with Procurement and Legal; prepare renewals and renegotiations.
  • Run monthly operational reviews and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with each 3PL; agree and track improvement plans.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for 3PL partners and for internal teams on 3PL-related issues.
  1. Operations Control
  • Set and enforce operating standards for 3PLs: receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and returns (RMA).
  • Ensure 3PLs follow Nebius SOPs for handling heavy, fragile, high-value equipment (racks, GPU servers, HSM devices).
  • Monitor daily operational performance through WMS data, reports and site visits; act on deviations.
  • Lead root-cause analysis of incidents (damage, loss, mis-shipments, delays) and follow corrective and preventive actions to closure.
  1. Inventory Control & Audits
  • Ensure inventory accuracy at external sites: cycle counts, annual stock takes and reconciliation with ERP/WMS.
  • Organise periodic on-site audits and inspections of 3PL warehouses (process, security, safety, documentation).
  • Coordinate with Back Office on stock discrepancies, adjustments and asset records.
  • Support internal and external (SOX) audits for inventory held by third parties.
  1. Coordination with Internal Teams
  • Align inbound and outbound volumes with Logistics Planning and Transport so 3PLs have capacity and labour in time.
  • Coordinate with ITDC and Project Managers on staging, kitting and release of hardware to data center sites.
  • Work with Security on access control, CCTV, pre-arrival information and secure-storage requirements at 3PL sites.
  • Ensure accurate and timely data exchange between 3PL systems and Nebius ERP/WMS (integrations, ASNs, stock reports).
  1. Cost Management
  • Own the 3PL budget: storage, handling, value-added services and accessorial charges.
  • Validate 3PL invoices against contracts and actual activity together with Back Office; resolve disputes.
  • Track cost per pallet / rack / movement and identify savings through consolidation, space optimisation and renegotiation.
  1. Network Development: Onboarding & Exit
  • Assess needs for new external storage based on DC expansion plans and capacity forecasts.
  • Lead 3PL selection (RFI/RFQ, site assessment) with Procurement and onboard new partners: SOPs, system setup, training, go-live.
  • Manage 3PL exits and stock transfers with zero loss and full traceability.
  1. Compliance & Risk
  • Ensure 3PL operations meet security, safety, insurance and customs requirements (e.g. bonded storage where applicable).
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation on contracts, SLAs, audits and incidents.
  • Identify operational and dependency risks in the 3PL network and maintain contingency plans.
  1. Team Leadership
  • Lead 3PL / External Warehouse Specialists as the function scales; set priorities, onboard and develop them.
  • Define workflows, responsibilities and escalation paths between the 3PL team, Warehouse Operations and Transport.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI

Definition

SLA compliance

% of 3PL SLA targets met (dock-to-stock, order cycle time, on-time dispatch)

Inventory accuracy

% match between 3PL physical stock and Nebius ERP/WMS

Incident rate

Damage, loss and mis-shipment cases per 1,000 movements

CAPA closure

% of corrective actions closed by due date

Audit results

Score / findings from 3PL on-site audits and SOX tests

Cost per unit

3PL cost per pallet / rack / movement vs. budget

Invoice accuracy

% of 3PL invoices matching contract and activity without dispute

Expectations

Autonomy: Full ownership of the 3PL network and partner performance; escalates contract, budget and major-risk decisions.

Impact: Directly affects hardware availability, inventory accuracy and warehousing cost across all external sites.

Leadership: Leads 3PL specialists and steers partner teams without direct authority.

Travel: Regular trips to 3PL sites for audits, reviews and onboarding.

Work Mode: Hybrid, with regular presence at key logistics sites.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

title: Community Manager – French Speaking (12-Month Contract)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are searching for a strategic community management and operations expert to join the International Community team and help grow Reddit outside of the US. As an integral part of the International Growth team, this role plays a key role in helping Reddit realize its mission: bringing community and belonging to everyone in the world.

This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland.

As the Community Manager, you will be at the forefront of jumpstarting and fostering local communities. You will be an expert of the French market, proficient in English and French, and focused on proactive initiatives to build bridges with local volunteer moderators and innovate, iterate, refine, and scale our international consumer playbook. The insights derived from your relationships and experiments will help accelerate our growth in the market.

What you will do:

  • Gain a deep understanding of the market to identify user and local moderator challenges, and market opportunities.
  • Iterate, innovate, and scale the consumer growth playbook by recognizing new opportunities, suggesting bold ideas and programs, and persuading internal teams to align on new plans.
  • Build strategic plans to cultivate, recruit, educate, and grow a local community of moderators (i.e., volunteers who develop, maintain, and shape the culture of local communities). Implement a conversion funnel designed to onboard power users and external creators, transforming them into active moderators.
  • Communicate quantitative and qualitative insights to optimize and improve the international consumer growth playbook.
  • Be obsessive about achieving aggressive goals and outcomes.
  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data, set KPIs, and execute impactful community initiatives: leverage data to uncover community and moderator insights that will influence the direction of the local team in the market.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Community, Engineering, Marketing, Safety, and BD teams.

What We Can Expect From You:

  • 5+ years of community development, project management, growth, operations, or product consulting experience with a track record of community-led projects that have driven business impact.
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of French culture, including current events, politics, customs, traditions, language, topics of interest, and taboos.
  • Nuanced comprehension of the digital landscape and the cultural intricacies inherent within it, including awareness of internet culture specific to France and an appreciation for the diverse cultural facets shaping contemporary French society.
  • Succinct and persuasive communicator: able to collaborate effectively across internal teams, local users, moderators, partners, content creators, influencers, etc.
  • Results-obsessed: demonstrates outstanding execution and high attention to detail.
  • Deep interest in developing and driving projects, framing issues and seeking solutions, testing hypotheses, and iterating on process improvements.
  • Proficiency in French & English.

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

title: Complaints Policy Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London OR Cardiff OR Remote (UK) | 💰 £51,200- £64,700 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits ✨

⭐Our Complaints team

Our mission is to make money work for everyone. And while having a great app is part of that, we pride ourselves on providing world-class support. By solving customers' problems, treating them fairly and being transparent, we believe we can make banking better 💪

Our Complaints team works alongside Customer Operations to make sure customers receive the best possible service, even when things go wrong. We put empathy at the heart of how we handle complaints and use what we learn to make things better.

As our Complaints Policy Manager, you'll lead a team of technical experts and shape how we handle complaints across Monzo. You'll bring together regulatory requirements, customer needs and operational priorities to make sure our policies are clear, effective and fair. You'll play an important role in strengthening our complaints framework, influencing decisions across the business and helping us deliver better customer outcomes at scale.

🔑You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Complaints Lead Experts, creating an environment where people can grow and deliver high-quality technical advice.

  • Owning and improving our complaints policy framework, making sure processes, guidance, systems and customer communications are consistent, effective and meet regulatory expectations.

  • Providing oversight and direction on complex complaint handling issues, supporting teams to make fair, well-informed decisions across different complaint types.

  • Using insights from quality assurance, Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) outcomes and escalations to identify root causes, shape our strategy and drive meaningful improvements.

  • Partnering with Product, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Operations leaders to develop and embed policies, frameworks and operational changes that improve customer experiences.

  • Leading our response to regulatory developments, audits and compliance reviews, making sure our controls, reporting and governance remain robust.

  • Overseeing specialist activities, including regulatory disclosures, legal escalations and engagement with third parties, to make sure we meet our obligations and deliver fair customer outcomes.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have strong knowledge of UK complaint-handling regulations, including the FCA's DISP handbook and FOS requirements, and can apply them to real customer situations.

  • You're experienced in leading, coaching and developing technical specialists, helping them build confidence and deliver great outcomes.

  • You can see the bigger picture, using complaint data, quality insights and emerging trends to shape strategy and improve how things work.

  • You're comfortable managing regulatory governance, control frameworks, audits and changes to regulatory requirements.

  • You can build strong relationships across different teams, influence senior stakeholders and turn complex regulatory information into clear, practical guidance.

  • You're confident balancing long-term strategic priorities with day-to-day operational challenges, making thoughtful decisions and keeping things moving.

  • You're passionate about fair customer outcomes and finding ways to make complaint handling simpler, more consistent and more empathetic.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌What’s in it for you

  • 💰£51,200 - £64,700 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits

  • ⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

  • 📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

  • 🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

  • ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

1. Application
2. Recruiter Call
3. Role specific Interview
4. Values Interview

This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

🤖 We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!

LinkedIn Tags: #LI-JK1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Premises Team Member
description:
Winchmore is a large, thriving, and fast-paced secondary school serving over 1800 students across a substantial, multi-building campus. We are looking for a practical, proactive, and reliable Premises Team Member to join our dedicated Premises team. The Hours are 41-45 hours per week (2,137-2,346 annualised hours) on a shift rota, as required to meet the needs of the School. The Shift pattern is as follows - Early: 5.30am to 2.30pm, Middle: 8.00am to 5.00pm, Late: 1.30pm to 10.30pm, and every 3rd Saturday.

Key Responsibilities

  • Site Security: Act as a designated keyholder, carrying out daily opening and locking-up procedures, setting security alarms, and responding to out-of-hours call-outs on a rota basis.

  • Maintenance & Repairs: Undertake a wide range of general maintenance, basic DIY, painting, decorating, carpentry, and minor plumbing tasks across the site.

  • Health & Safety Compliance: Conduct and log routine statutory checks (including fire alarm tests, emergency lighting, and water temperature/legionella flushing) and report any hazards promptly.

  • Events, Exams & Porterage: Set up and clear down furniture and equipment for assemblies, public examinations, parents’ evenings, and community lettings, as well as managing parcel and stock deliveries.

  • Grounds & Presentation: Maintain clean, litter-free external areas, clear leaves and snow during winter months, and support the cleaning team with urgent daytime spillages or hygiene needs.

  • Contractor Liaison: Escort external contractors on site, ensuring they adhere to school safeguarding and Health & Safety protocols.

What We Are Looking For

  • Practical experience in building maintenance, a trade, caretaking, or general DIY, with the confidence to use a variety of hand and power tools safely.

  • An awareness of Health & Safety legislation and safe working practices (training in areas such as Manual Handling, Working at Height, and Legionella awareness will be provided).

  • The physical fitness required for manual handling, lifting, and working across a large, multi-storey site.

  • A calm, adaptable, and customer-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively within a team and under pressure and prioritise tasks in a busy school environment.

  • Flexibility to work a rotating shift pattern, including early mornings, late evenings, and every 3rd Saturday.

What We Offer
  • Winchmore is known for being a friendly and supportive School Community. We provide a range of well-being activities and facilities, good transport links, free local parking, a cycle to work scheme, use of a brand new fitness suite. We value our staff and recognise the importance of maintaining a healthy work life balance.

title: Site Operative
description:
The role

The University of Cambridge Primary School is looking for a skilled, practical and reliable Site Operative to join our site team. Working alongside our Site Manager, you will help keep our building and grounds safe, secure, well maintained and ready for learning for around 700 children, their families and the team who work here.

This is a hands-on role. Your week will include repairs and maintenance, caring for our grounds and outdoor play spaces, setting up rooms for events and visitors, and carrying out the routine safety checks that keep everyone safe. You will share opening, locking and key-holding with the Site Manager so that the site is covered across the school day, and you will work four weeks of the school holidays, when much of our maintenance and the annual deep clean take place.

Our school

Our building is purpose-built and open-plan by design, at the heart of the Eddington community in north-west Cambridge. The environment is part of how children learn here, so the way the site looks, feels and works matters. We welcome visitors and delegations from across the world, and we want every one of them to see a building that is cared for.

We work in a spirit of trust. That comes with high expectations and high accountability, and with a supportive team who are ambitious for our children.

Who we are looking for

You will have practical craft skills and experience of building maintenance, a good understanding of health and safety (we will provide training), a sharp eye for detail and the confidence to work on your own initiative. You will be as comfortable fixing a door as you are talking with a child about why you are fixing it. You will be flexible, calm when something goes wrong, and someone who takes pride in a job done properly.

What we offer

A friendly, two-person site team and a supportive wider team

Training and development, including health and safety and compliance training

Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme

A well-being day each year and access to an Employee Assistance Programme

Cycle to Work scheme, a University Visit Card and discounted membership of the University Sports Centre

Find out more and apply

Visits to the school are warmly welcomed. To arrange one, or for an informal conversation about the role, please email enquiries@universityprimaryschool.org.uk.

Please apply through MyNewTerm, using the person specification to show how you meet each criterion. Shortlisting is based on the evidence in your application.

UCPS is a standalone academy trust. All team members are employed by the trust, not by the University of Cambridge.

In line with Keeping Children Safe in Education, we may carry out online searches on shortlisted candidates. This post is subject to an enhanced DBS check, including a children's barred list check, and satisfactory references. We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community.

title: Head of Year
description:
Job Purpose

To ensure that Form Tutors:

  • help ensure that all students in the year group make maximum progress across the curriculum. This particularly applies to vulnerable students and the successful candidate will work closely with the Assistant Headteacher – Inclusion Lead, in this regard;
  • communicate and empathise with families of students in the year group ensuring they remain engaged with their son/daughter’s progress at school;
  • work closely with the pastoral facilitators to ensure students are supported and challenged as necessary and achieve optimum levels of engagement with school life;
  • help maximise student attendance in conjunction with the attendance officer;
  • role model excellent practices including going ‘above and beyond’ and intervening with students outside the curriculum as necessary;
  • ensure that students are correctly equipped and parents are held to account for providing their son/ daughter with the tools students need to learn effectively;
  • communicate appropriate information to teaching and support staff;
  • are highly visible and a point of contact for students.

Safeguarding

  • To be familiar with school policies, in particular safeguarding procedures, and promote the welfare of children.
  • To train to be a safeguarding officer.

Key responsibilities

To ensure that Form Tutors:

  • help raise the aspirations of vulnerable and pupil premium students;
  • help contribute to high levels of student attendance and punctuality;
  • be a point of contact for students and families when personal matters affect learning and progress;
  • support and challenge Heads of Department so that underachieving students ‘catch up’, particularly in Maths, English and Science;
  • contribute to a confidential record of issues affecting the educational progress of students;
  • work with agencies in school and beyond to support students and their families, conducting home visits when required;
  • lead and deliver assemblies;
  • ensure school uniform is worn correctly;
  • produce internal and external reports as necessary;
  • work within school systems on safeguarding and communication to inform teaching and non-teaching staff about issues affecting students’ progress and wellbeing;
  • work with parents, as necessary, to engage them in their child’s education and support their child’s achievement;
  • promote positive attitudes to learning and behaviour for learning with vulnerable students;
  • liaise with the SEND Department to ensure the best cohesive support packages are in place for the most vulnerable students;
  • monitor, evaluate and review attitude to learning within the year group, developing and implementing strategies as required in conjunction with Assistant Headteacher- Pastoral Lead;
  • uphold and promote the values and ethos of the school;
  • lead and ensure the smooth running of parents’ evening, analysing attendance and impact;
  • supervise students in the reflection room, conduct regular restorative justice and run readmission meetings;
  • attend, contribute and monitor those students on a pastoral support plan;
  • attend and contribute proactively to the weekly 8.00am (day subject to change) pastoral meeting;
  • ensure policies and procedures are effectively implemented by the year team;
  • ensure that all students in your year group arrive promptly to school and lessons, dressed ready to learn and take part in designated daily tasks;
  • conduct learning walks with varied foci;
  • implement the 10 Typical best practices consistently;
  • support and challenge the Pastoral Facilitators so that the balance is found between caring for student’s well being and caring for their performance in the curriculum.

Person Specification

  • A willingness to embrace a growth mindset.

  • A commitment to help students improve Cultural Capital so that their chances of success in the world are enhanced.
  • A motivated individual who can inspire.
  • The ability to ‘absorb’ the challenges of the day and still maintain high standards of professionalism.
  • A team player putting students first and working with colleagues efficiently and effectively; recognising the ‘greater good’ and playing a full part in #TeamBlenheim.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills both orally and in writing.
  • A genuine interest and enjoyment in working with teenage students, educators, schools and learning.
  • Ability to demonstrate flexibility and tenacity.
  • Confident, assertive and able to thrive in a challenging environment.
  • Ability to motivate pupils through a variety of methods, including competition, rewards, sanctions and the setting of SMART goals.
  • Ability to interpret and track student progress through the use of data.
  • Ability to successfully encourage students to achieve their academic and social potential.
  • A commitment to provide a supporting and challenging environment for students, particularly vulnerable students including those with Special Educational Needs.
  • A commitment to individual continuous professional development, wanting to ‘get better’ by building on strengths but also recognising development areas and actively seeking to improve them.

General

  • Demonstrate a keen interest in all aspects of school life.
  • Show solidarity by supporting school policy, and the leadership team, publicly.
  • Challenge school policy, and the leadership team, privately.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duty as directed by the Headteacher.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
FIXED TERM - 1 YEAR

We are delighted to be growing our SEND team and are looking for a proactive Learning Support Assistant to join our hardworking and inclusive environment. This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who is committed to nurturing the whole child, ensuring that every pupil receives the tailored support they need to achieve their full academic and social potential.

We are seeking a candidate who can bring either some subject knowledge or have a genuine interest for supporting students with their learning. Your enthusiasm will be key in helping our students unlock the curriculum, as you find creative ways to bring subjects to life for learners with varying barriers to learning.

We are looking for a professional who thrives on variety and possesses the flexibility to adapt across the school as required. You will be someone that is able to step in where support is needed and will have the greatest impact on our pupils' day.

At the Sele School, our purpose is to enrich the lives of every single young person and empower every child to successfully write their next chapter —whether that is further education, employment, or training. We explicitly measure our success by the long-term readiness and future security of our students. Our Three Core Values are: Belong, Thrive and Succeed.

The Successful Candidate will:

  • Prioritise Connection: You understand that "connection before correction" is the foundation of success, bringing a natural ability to build warm, positive relationships that help our pupils feel safe and ready to learn.
  • Be a Team Player: You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working as part of an expanding team. You are happy to take direction and move fluidly to wherever the school or our pupils need you most, always putting their needs at the heart of your day.
  • Combine Subject & SEND Knowledge: You bring a strong toolkit of subject knowledge and SEND understanding. This expertise allows you to break down barriers to learning, providing the informed support and "scaffolding" pupils need to master new skills.
  • Show Initiative: You have the confidence to work independently and the "thinking on your feet" skills required to adapt in the moment, ensuring support remains effective even when situations change.
  • Communicate with Purpose: You possess excellent interpersonal skills, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues, parents, and pupils at all levels.
  • Bring Positivity: You approach challenges with a resilient "can-do" attitude and a good sense of humour that inspires those around you.
  • Promote The Sele School’s ethos and values.

What can we offer you?

The chance to work in a positive, welcoming and forward-thinking community where evidence-based methods are seamlessly integrated into teaching and learning.

A dedicated staff who are enthusiastic and who want the best for students.

Coaching provision for all those new to the school within a comprehensive and fully developed induction programme.

A CPD package which is tailored to suit your stage of career development.

Cycle to work scheme which is part of the school’s sustainability strategy.

If you wish to learn more about the school, please feel free to view the videos on our school website which can be found on the “About Us - School Vision and Ethos” page.

We understand some may wish to see the school in action. If you wish to visit the school or meet on Teams, please contact the Heads PA at hr@sele.herts.sch.uk

Applications must be made using the school application form (CVs, or applications made using any other format, will not be accepted) and should be emailed to the address above for the attention of Madeline Genovese, to be considered for interview.

The Sele School community is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and all staff and volunteers are expected to demonstrate this commitment in all aspects of their work. Applicants for this post must be willing to undergo child protection training. A full enhanced DBS check will be undertaken and references will be sought prior to appointment start date.
