title: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 About the Team

 As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

 With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

 We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions. With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

 What You'll Do

• Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow.

• Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit

• Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines

• Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isn’t always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

• Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind

• Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't

• Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics

• Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

• Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly

• Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

 What You'll Bring

• Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments

• A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)

• Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

• Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

• Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

• Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

• Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

• Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

• A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus

• Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

• Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others

• Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same

• Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners

• Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed

• A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals

• Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices

• Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

 This Role is a Great Fit If

• You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows

• You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

• You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work

• You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example

• You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others

• You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it

• You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first

• You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

 Applying

 Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

 When applying please include:

 A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

 Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.

 About Netlify

 Netlify is a platform that lets you create, share, and run anything on the web: a website, an app, an agent experience, whatever you can dream up. Use your own tools or ours to build it, collaborate with your team, get it live, and keep it running. Anyone, from people just starting out to seasoned developers, can create pro-level web experiences that really work, really well.

 We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

 At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $182,000 - $248,000 for most US-based locations, $175,000 - $235,000 CAD in most Canada-based locations, and £105,000 – £144,000 GBP for most UK-based locations. Candidates outside the US, Canada, UK, or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Actual Salary: £23,994 to £25,116 pa incl. Fringe

Start Date: ASAP

Rickmansworth School is seeking a dedicated PE Technician to join our supportive team. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in supporting the delivery of high-quality PE lessons and sporting activities, helping students to develop their skills, confidence and enjoyment of physical activity.

In your role as a PE Technician, you will deliver hands-on assistance to the PE Department, manage and prepare sports equipment, and support lessons as well as athletic fixtures to foster student engagement in sport. Additionally, you will perform lifeguard duties at the School’s swimming pool, promote healthy and active living throughout the School community and carry out morning supervision at the main entrance gate. You would either hold a National Pool Lifeguard Qualification (NPLQ) or show strong commitment to gaining this qualification on appointment.

If you are enthusiastic about sport and physical activity, well organised and committed to supporting students’ development, we would love to hear from you. Join us in encouraging participation and helping students achieve their potential. The role includes exciting opportunities to complete national accredited qualifications through a local apprenticeship provider.

About the PE Department

The PE Department is at the heart of school life at Rickmansworth School and is highly respected by students, parents and staff.

The department is very successful within the School and community, winning the Hertfordshire Service to Sport ‘Secondary School PE department of the Year’ for three consecutive years. We are also proud to hold the School Games Platinum Award. The PE department has state of the art sports facilities, including a large sportshall, fitness suite and dance studio. The department also has a recently refurbished swimming pool, astroturf multi-use games area and extensive playing fields.

Extra-curricular sport plays an important role in the ethos of the department. We run an extensive programme, including providing opportunities before school, at lunch times, after school and on Saturday mornings. Our aim is to offer a wide variety of activities so that as many students as possible can take part and enjoy physical activity and have the opportunity to represent the school.

The department runs a number of sports tours and trips to further enhance opportunities for our students. We currently organise and run an annual ski trip as well as Football and Netball trips, with a long haul trip to Sri Lanka planned for 2028 after a successful trip to South Africa in 2026.

The department currently consists of seven teaching members of staff. We work closely with the Three Rivers and Watford School Sports Partnership that we are proud to host at Rickmansworth School.

In return, we will offer you:

  • Outstanding CPD opportunities to support your professional growth

  • A school with exemplary student behaviour, where learning is valued

  • A collaborative working environment where teamwork is at the heart of everything we do

  • Highly skilled and supportive staff, working together to make a difference

  • A comprehensive wellbeing programme to ensure you feel valued and supported

Rickmansworth School is an outstanding, heavily over-subscribed 11-18 co-educational academy, consistently achieving excellent academic results. We provide a nurturing and dynamic environment for our 1575 ambitious young people. Our strong academic track record at both GCSE and A-Level ensures that the vast majority of our students go on to their first-choice universities

Further information is available from our website - https://www.rickmansworth.herts.sch.uk

We encourage potential candidates to contact Rickmansworth School for an informal discussion about the role or to arrange a visit to the School, please contact the School on 01923 773296 or email applications@rickmansworth.herts.sch.uk.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and are an equal opportunities employer who has a zero tolerance to bullying and all types of harassment. Applicants must declare any criminal convictions and submit to a check with the Disclosing and Barring Service as the post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974.

title: SEMH Support Worker
description:
St Matthew’s Primary School is looking for a SEMH (Social Emotional Mental Health) Support Worker for January 2027.

Whilst St Matthew’s is one of the largest primary schools in Luton, it has a calm, personal and happy atmosphere. We are a big school with small community habits and pride ourselves on everyone’s personal, academic and professional well-being and this is a cornerstone of our ethos. The sense of being in an ambitious, supportive family is often commented on by children, parents, staff and visitors alike.

Our inclusion work is ever growing and we have decided to add this post into our Inclusion Team to work alongside our Assistant Head for Inclusion and SENDCo.

Finding the right people to work with our children is paramount. So if you want children to feel safe, be happy, be excited, love coming to school and to progress each and every day no matter what their starting points, and you want to work with a wholly child centred leadership team, please apply.

From our new SEMH Support Worker we ask you to:

  • Understand and believe that all children can make progress when provided with the right provision, teaching, support and care.

  • Have extensive experience of supporting children with additional needs, particularly those with social, emotional and behavioural needs.

  • Demonstrate patience, empathy, resilience and a genuine understanding of the individual needs of children.

  • Be flexible and adaptable, recognising that every child is different and requires an individualised approach.

  • Be confident working independently, using your own initiative, as well as contributing positively to a wider team.

  • Have a sound understanding of trauma-informed practice, emotional regulation and positive behaviour support, with the ability to respond calmly and confidently to challenging situations.

  • Be a positive, optimistic and proactive team player who brings energy, commitment and enthusiasm to the role.

  • Have excellent administrative, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records and manage competing priorities.

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to your own ongoing professional development and a willingness to continually reflect on and improve your practice.

  • Be committed to building positive, trusting relationships with pupils and providing consistent, nurturing support to help them achieve their full potential.

In return we can offer you:

  • A truly child centred, friendly and holistic school that values inclusion and diversity

  • A strong team and school community

  • A safe and nurturing environment for our staff as well as our pupils

  • A supportive and solution focused Team Leader and SLT who are dedicated to making a difference in the lives of all children

  • A true sense of social and moral purpose that the whole staff live by

As well as:

  • Dedicated specialist teams to support the work of all teaching teams

  • Lots of extra-curricular activities and inclusive trips for the children

  • Career Progression pathways

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Comprehensive whole school CPD programme

  • Comprehensive individual CPD programme

  • Onsite parking

  • A well-equipped staff room, access to school lunches and a central location with many amenities in very short walking distance

We all know a picture speaks a thousand words, so a visit to St Matthew’s is the only way to fully understand why you should want to work here…people who step over our threshold are amazed by the atmosphere, calmness and vibrancy of our school.

If we sound like the school for you, please call for an informal chat about this post, arrange a visit or simply apply now.

This post is term time only, 8:15am - 3:45pm, Monday to Friday.

The successful applicant will start at the bottom of the L4 salary range unless already paid on an L4 grade in a similar role.

title: Attendance Officer
description:
Job Purpose:

To monitor and report on whole-school attendance data, analysing data to identify key areas of concern. To work closely with pupils, staff, parents and carers to reduce levels of absence, and act appropriately when persistent absence becomes a safeguarding issue.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Administration

Working within the Student Services area, including the student reception area.

Receiving telephone calls from parents/carers related to absences/lateness.

Ensure daily attendance registers are accurate and complete and follow up with staff members about any incomplete data.

Follow up on any unexplained absences with parents/carers, escalating issues as appropriate in line with school procedures.

Initiate and oversee the administration of absence procedures, for example letters home, attendance clinics and engagement with local authorities/other external agencies and partners.

Manage attendance returns for the school census.

Manage the process of issuing penalty notices to parents.

Maintain accurate records of communication with parents/carers and relevant interventions.

Monitoring and Reporting

Produce and interpret attendance reports for school leaders, identifying key statistics, reasons for absence and any patterns of concern.

Track attendance of vulnerable groups of pupils and share information with school leaders.

Identify pupils that need additional support to improve their attendance.

Work with school leaders to identify appropriate interventions to improve attendance for particular groups or individual pupils.

Lead daily or weekly check-ins to review progress and the impact of support/interventions.

Work with school leaders to develop and revise the school’s attendance policy.

Implement children missing education (CME) procedures when appropriate.

Provide regular reports to attendance organisations to raise awareness of emerging at-risk pupils.

Produce attendance data for half-term awards.

Produce a daily absence report for staff in Excel, detailing student’s reason for absence.

St John Henry Newman Catholic School is seeking to appoint an experienced, highly organised and forward-thinking Operations Manager to join our School Leadership Team.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the strategic and operational leadership of our school. Working closely with the Headteacher, senior leaders and the Holy Cross Catholic MAC Central Team, you will ensure that the school’s business and support services are effective, efficient and responsive to the needs of our students, staff and wider community.

The successful candidate will lead and coordinate a broad portfolio of services, including:

  • human resources and payroll administration;
  • estates, premises and site management;
  • health and safety, risk management and business continuity;
  • ICT oversight and cyber-security planning;
  • catering, cleaning and contract management; and
  • school administration and statutory compliance.

As the point of contact for the school’s finances, you will work in partnership with the MAC central finance team to support budget planning, maintain strong financial controls, provide high-quality management information and ensure resources are used effectively and deliver best value. You will also oversee key HR systems and processes, line-manage designated staff and help ensure the school’s records, Single Central Record and management information systems remain accurate and compliant.

  • has a successful record of leading and motivating staff;
  • can manage change and implement effective systems, procedures and controls;
  • understands financial management, procurement, contract management and value for money;
  • has a sound understanding of health and safety, employment practices and equal opportunities;
  • communicates confidently and builds positive relationships with colleagues, students, governors and external partners;
  • can prioritise competing demands, remain calm under pressure and take a practical, hands-on approach; and
  • is committed to safeguarding and to supporting the Catholic ethos, aims and mission of the school.

In September 2026, our new school building opened on the existing site, marking an important new chapter for our community. Formerly Cardinal Newman Catholic School, we move forward with a new name and outstanding new surroundings while retaining our deep commitment to ensuring that every child feels known, valued and inspired.

This is also an important time for Catholic education locally, as Holy Cross Catholic MAC prepares to become part of St Raphael the Archangel CMAT from September 2027. The successful candidate will therefore join us at a time of development, opportunity and positive change.

Our school is committed to forming Christ-centred pilgrims of hope, with kind hearts, questioning minds, a thirst for knowledge and a hunger for justice. We welcome applications from candidates who will embrace our mission and help us provide the very best environment in which our students and staff can flourish.

Interviews planned for Thursday 3 December 2026

Our Cover Supervisor position presents a fantastic opportunity for candidates who are potentially looking to gain experience to progress into teaching, or for those who aspire to work within the areas of Social and Emotional Mental Health or SEND. The development of our staff and students is of paramount importance to us and as such there will be further opportunities for the successful candidate. This would be an ideal position for someone looking to develop valuable skills towards a possible teaching career or other profession linked to education in the future. 

As part of this role, you would facilitate the smooth and effective delivery of the curriculum across all school subject areas. The successful applicant will be hard working, flexible, and have excellent communication skills. It is essential that any applicant enjoys working with and supporting young people, as this is an essential part of the role. Your focus will be on supporting progress by providing classroom supervision for students whose regular teacher is absent. You will be expected to deliver pre-planned learning activities posted on the Teams platform and establish productive working relationships with students in a stimulating and orderly learning environment. Full training and unstinting support will be available, to allow the successful candidate to flourish in the post. English to GCSE or equivalent is required. 

St Mary’s is a very popular and happy school, rated Outstanding by the Diocese and Ofsted. We became an academy in 2013 and enjoy outstanding facilities in a new building, which opened in 2011. We joined the Bishop Bewick Catholic Education Trust in June 2020. We are also very popular with parents and are one of the most over-subscribed schools in the North-East. The roll has grown from around 1100 five years ago to over 1440 by September 2026, with 5 main school year groups of around 235 and a Sixth Form of approximately 270 students. We expect the Sixth Form to continue to grow in the next couple of years, as strongly academic year groups continue to move into Sixth Form.

This is a wonderful opportunity to join a highly successful and forward-thinking school.

As an Outstanding school, St Mary’s plays a leading role within the Trust and more widely, leading significant school improvement, training and leadership development across other schools, as well as sharing good practice in academic achievement and teaching and learning across many other schools in the north-east. We also play a leading role in teacher training across the region. Many opportunities for professional development and further training would be available. 

To apply, please complete the CES online application form via Eteach. Please complete the application in full including the ‘Supporting Statement’ section which should be around 1 side of A4 in length. title: Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL)
description:
About the Role

As Designated Safeguarding Lead, you will provide operational leadership for the College's safeguarding function, ensuring safeguarding concerns are managed effectively, statutory duties are fulfilled and students receive timely and appropriate support.

Working closely with the Senior Designated Safeguarding Lead, curriculum leaders, student services teams and external safeguarding agencies, you will oversee safeguarding activity across the College, manage the DDSL team and ensure that safeguarding practice is consistent, robust and student-centred.

You will lead on safeguarding quality assurance, manage complex and high-risk cases, oversee safeguarding data and reporting, and act as the College's lead practitioner for CPOMS, ensuring effective safeguarding record keeping and case management across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Safeguarding Leadership

  • Lead the day-to-day safeguarding function across the College Group.
  • Provide operational leadership for safeguarding, child protection, vulnerable adult safeguarding and Prevent.
  • Maintain oversight of safeguarding concerns, referrals, investigations and interventions.
  • Promote a strong safeguarding culture across all campuses and provisions.
  • Deputise for the Senior Designated Safeguarding Lead when required.

Leadership & Management

  • Line manage and supervise the Deputy Designated Safeguarding Leads and wider safeguarding staff.
  • Lead safeguarding supervision, case reviews and team development activities.
  • Monitor service performance, caseloads and operational effectiveness.
  • Drive high standards of safeguarding practice and continuous improvement across the team.

Case Management & Multi-Agency Working

  • Provide leadership and oversight of complex and high-risk safeguarding cases.
  • Ensure appropriate referrals are made to Children's Social Care, Adult Social Care, Police, Prevent partners and other agencies.
  • Chair safeguarding meetings and represent the College at multi-agency safeguarding forums.
  • Work collaboratively with external partners to achieve positive outcomes for students.

CPOMS, Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Act as the College's lead practitioner for CPOMS and safeguarding information management.
  • Lead safeguarding audits, quality assurance reviews and compliance monitoring.
  • Analyse safeguarding data, trends and emerging risks.
  • Produce reports and management information for senior leaders and governors.
  • Ensure safeguarding records meet statutory and regulatory requirements.

Training & Safeguarding Culture

  • Deliver safeguarding and Prevent training across the College.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance to managers and staff.
  • Support safeguarding awareness activities and preventative interventions.
  • Contribute to the development of safeguarding policies and procedures.

About You

We are looking for an experienced safeguarding leader with a proven track record of managing complex safeguarding concerns and leading high-performing teams. You will be confident working in a fast-paced environment, making informed safeguarding decisions and influencing practice across a large organisation.

Essential Requirements

  • Significant safeguarding experience within education, social care or a related safeguarding environment.
  • Experience of managing complex safeguarding and child protection cases.
  • Experience of supervising or managing safeguarding practitioners or safeguarding teams.
  • Experience of multi-agency safeguarding working and statutory safeguarding processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in CPOMS or an equivalent safeguarding case management system.
  • Excellent safeguarding risk assessment, decision-making and leadership skills.
  • Strong communication, report-writing and stakeholder-management abilities.
  • Commitment to safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion.

Desirable

  • Previous experience as a Designated Safeguarding Lead or Deputy Designated Safeguarding Lead.
  • Experience within Further Education.
  • Advanced DSL, Prevent or Safer Recruitment training.
  • Knowledge of Ofsted safeguarding expectations within the FE sector.

description:
The Governing Board is seeking to appoint an enthusiastic and well-qualified teacher of Languages to join the school from January 2027. The successful candidate will be a French specialist. French is currently taught across Key Stages 3 and 4; Latin is taught at Key Stage 3 and Key Stage 4. The ability to teach both subjects, while not essential, is highly desirable. Because we are looking to expand our languages curriculum to include Key Stage 5 French in the near future, the ability to deliver French to A Level standard will be an advantage.

The successful candidate will model at least good teaching practice and will be able to engage and inspire students of all abilities both in and out of lessons. They will also be keen to contribute to the school’s extra-curricular life to enhance the opportunities available to our students. A bespoke CPD programme will be tailored to meeting their needs.

St. John Fisher Catholic Comprehensive School is a non-selective coeducational secondary school for students aged 11-18. A single site school with free parking, we moved to world-class brand-new buildings in the spring of 2023. Our mission statement is that ‘St. John Fisher Catholic Comprehensive School inspires students, spiritually and educationally forming them through Faith so that they can achieve their aspirations and contribute to their community’. As a Catholic school, we are passionate about the formation of the whole student, making sure that we develop students into good people as well as ensure they get good results.

The school is in Medway, a 30-minute distance from London by road or high-speed rail link. Medway benefits from a multimillion-pound regeneration programme bringing new housing developments and facilities for its inhabitants; it also has the lowest council tax rates in Kent.

We are happy to offer visits and informal discussions of the role: please contact Deputy Headteacher Victoria Walker at v.walker@stjohnfisher.school for further information.

Interviews will take place shortly after the closing date

title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

title: Quantum Research Scientist
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://www.MANTECH.com

 Description & Requirements

Elevate your career with MANTECH International Corporation! Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Since 1968, MANTECH has led in delivering advanced solutions to government intelligence, the Department of Defense, and Federal Civilian sectors. Dive into innovation in Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—be extraordinary at MANTECH!

 ***This is for a future opportunity***

 MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Quantum Research Scientist to join our team in a remote role.
 The Quantum Research Scientist will advance quantum information science and optical quantum systems, leveraging expertise in continuous-variable photonics and theoretical algorithm discovery to translate complex physical phenomena into experimental prototypes and publishable research.

 Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 • Conducting foundational and applied research to advance quantum information science, with a specialized focus on continuous-variable (CV) photonic quantum computing.
• Leading theoretical algorithm discovery, establishing novel qubit modalities, and engineering advanced error-correction schemes tailored for optical and photonic quantum systems.
• Prioritizing experimental physics integration within photonics modalities over alternative architectures.
• Translating complex mathematical models and quantum physical phenomena into experimental prototypes, technical specifications, and publishable findings.
• Collaborating closely with academic partners and cross-functional engineering teams to map cross-platform control policies to alternative modalities.
• Documenting research progress and disseminating findings through technical papers, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.

 Minimum Qualifications:
 • Master’s degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
• 4+ years of professional experience working in quantum computing or quantum information science.
• Demonstrated foundational research experience in theoretical algorithm discovery, novel qubit modalities, quantum error-correction schemes, or experimental quantum physics.
• Demonstrated experience translating complex mathematical models and physical phenomena into experimental prototypes or technical specifications.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

 Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI

 Role Overview

 Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect , redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.

 This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.

 As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.

 Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization

• Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.

• Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.

• Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.

• Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).

• Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.

• Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

 Data & AI Infrastructure

• Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.

• Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.

• Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.

• Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture

• Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.

• Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.

• Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

 GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy

• You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.

• You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.

• Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

 Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership

• Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.

• Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.

• Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

• Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

 Who You Are

• Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.

• Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.

• System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

• Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.

• Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.

• Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.

• Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

 Must-Have Skills & Experience

• 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.

• Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.

• Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.

• Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.

• Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.

• Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.

• Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).

• Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).

• Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.

• Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.

• Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

 Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

• Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.

• Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

 Why Join Us?

• Impact at scale —we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges .

• Modern technical foundation with room to innovate —leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.

• Hands-on architecture leadership —you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.

• Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts , pushing the limits of what’s possible.

• Competitive compensation and high ownership —your work will define how Jumio scales.

 Jumio Values:

 IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

 Equal Opportunities :

 Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

 About Jumio:

 Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

 Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

 Applicant Data Privacy

 We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

title: HR Enablement Lead
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Job Title: HR Enablement Lead

 Job Location: United States, Remote

 This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

 ABOUT THE COMPANY:

 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

 With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

 THE OPPORTUNITY:

 At Salesloft, as our HR Enablement Lead, you will be a pivotal member of our high-performing People team. Reporting to [manager, confirm], you will own the creation of learning programs and lead high-impact enablement workshops from beginning to end, and you will help build a cohesive, seamless learning journey for our global workforce. You'll have designated programs that you own end to end, from conception through execution, with hands-on support from leadership as the team builds out its capabilities together.

 You'll work closely with our People Business Partners, our Associate People Business Partner, and an L&D coordinator who supports the learning platform and content production. Together you will ramp front-line managers faster, equip the People team with the playbooks and training it needs, and make learning part of how the business runs. This role moves beyond administrative operations to focus on strategic partnership and the integration of AI to empower our people.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Own program lifecycles. Oversee end-to-end program lifecycles, including planning, development, delivery, and assessment.

• Create and lead workshops. Design and facilitate creative, robust enablement workshops and learning solutions for employees at all levels.

• Partner with People Business Partners. Work directly with People Business Partners to identify and align on specific talent gaps, and build solutions that fit what each business needs.

• Ramp front-line managers. Build and run manager and leadership programs, working with the PBPs, so new and developing managers can coach, handle performance conversations, and lead with confidence.

• Own onboarding and new-hire enablement. Create a consistent, practical onboarding experience that gets new employees productive faster.

• Enable the People team. Build playbooks, training and job aids for PBPs and Shared Services on topics such as calibration, employee relations and change management.

• Shape the learning architecture. Help architect a system of learning that is cohesive and provides a seamless journey for employees at all levels.

• Innovate with AI. Experiment with and implement AI-powered tools to automate workflows, personalize curriculum creation, and continuously invest in AI for workforce enablement.

• Drive business execution. Develop tailored strategies to address performance gaps, with clear objectives, development plans, and accountability measures, and make sure all programming aligns with near-term and long-term goals.

• Run the learning platform. Own the LMS and content library, working with the L&D coordinator on administration, scheduling and production.

• Analyze and interpret. Use data to identify trends, monitor program completions and impact, and provide actionable insights that inform future learning strategy.

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 We are seeking a strategic, results-driven partner who moves beyond operations to become a true consultant to the business. You are someone who understands how individual success drives company-wide goals and can build robust learning solutions that reflect the pragmatic needs of a fast-growing organization. You are comfortable embedding with the business and the People team. You build as well as plan: you ship programs, not just roadmaps, and you are equally at home designing a strategy and running the session. You care about proving that what you build works.

 THE SKILL SET:

• 5+ years of combined experience in learning and development, enablement, organizational development, HR, or a related field, ideally in a technology-driven environment.

• Workshop facilitation: Proven ability to lead engaging enablement workshops across a variety of formats (live, in-person, or remote).

• Manager and onboarding programs: Experience designing and delivering manager development and onboarding programs.

• Instructional innovation: Proven ability to experiment with emerging learning technologies, creative modalities, and unconventional approaches that push beyond traditional training while applying adult learning principles.

• Strategic partnership: Skilled at building trust and credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• AI and technical aptitude: Experience leveraging AI to automate workflows, analyze insights, or create curriculum; aptitude for maintaining learning technology systems.

• Systems thinking: Strong business acumen to understand how learning initiatives impact the broader organization and culture.

• Program ownership: Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently to see a program from concept to delivery.

• Hands-on execution: A track record of shipping programs and learning assets on a deadline, from design through delivery.

• Communication and influence: Effective communication skills to present findings and influence diverse audiences across many company levels.

• Instructional design: Strong foundation in instructional design methodologies and frameworks, with experience developing structured curriculum and learning objectives across diverse subject matters.

• Measurement: Experience measuring program impact and reporting results to leaders.

 At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Mexico

 Senior Integration Engineer

 Remote, Mexico

 JOB OVERVIEW

 Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.

 RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

 Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

 Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

 Technical Integrations

• Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.

• Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato

• Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.

• Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.

• Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.

• Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

 Legion Product Expertise

• Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.

• Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.

• Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues

• Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.

• Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.

• Write well-designed, testable, efficient code

• Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle

• Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

 Team Collaboration & Mentorship

• Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.

• Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.

• Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.

• Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.

• Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800

• This role involves participation in on-call rotation.

• This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience

• Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree

• Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.

• Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach

• Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.

• 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices

• Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC

• Experience using Linux/Unix environments

• Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.

• Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)

• 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2

• Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.

• Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services

• Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)

• Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.

• Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

• The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience

• Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic

• Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence

• Technical consulting experience.

• Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.

• Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.

 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

 We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

 Benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Health Benefits

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• Parental Leave

• Equity

• Monthly Wellness Reimbursement

• Monthly Lunch on Legion

 ABOUT LEGION

 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

 BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

title: Frontend Engineer, Ads
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Team Description

 The Brand Ad Formats team drives the development of ad formats that help advertisers maximize reach and brand impact. They focus on high-visibility, awareness-driven solutions that create memorable experiences for Reddit users. By delivering guaranteed placements and engaging ad interactions, they support major brand initiatives and help advertisers achieve measurable outcomes. The team is building fully customizable interactive formats and AI-driven ads that incorporate User-Generated Content (UGC). Moving forward, we will be doubling down on Video Ads, with the goal of turning Reddit into an industry leader and a ‘must buy’ for advertisers to promote video content.

 Role Description

 The Brand Ad Formats team is seeking a skilled Frontend engineer with a product-focused mindset to join the team.

 Responsibilities:

• Build Ad experiences and create patterns for Reddit’s web app that enhance our ads’ performance and functionality.

• Collaborate across product, design, and engineering teams to innovate and implement sophisticated solutions for complex challenges.

• Engage in the full development cycle: design, develop, QA, experiment, analyze, and deploy.

 Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in Web Engineering

• Proficient in Typescript and Javascript

• A willingness to tackle the challenges of creating data-intensive, highly responsive, and fault-tolerant apps

• Experience with automated testing best practices, code quality / design patterns, observability, etc.

• Skilled at performing insightful code reviews, and receiving feedback themself

• Experience leveraging GenAI tools to increase software engineering productivity

• Excellent communication skills: able to collaborate with teams in a fully remote environment, and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences

 Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working on ad tech

• Experience working on consumer facing sites (high production value at scale)

 Technologies used on the team include:

• Languages: Typescript, HTML, CSS, Go

• Frameworks: React, Thrift, gRPC

• Tools: Kubernetes, Docker, Codex, Cursor

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship - Warp Speed
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.
Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.
Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.
As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
The Role
 
Palantir has long been a landing spot for top Grandes Écoles engineering students and graduates. In this spirit, we are excited to launch a 12-month fellowship in New York City for students and recent graduates of the Grandes Écoles. Fellows will join alongside full-time Palantirians, supplemented with programming curated to fuel growth and criticality. Fellowships will begin October 2026. Candidates can participate in the fellowship during Grandes Écoles’ gap year, as a 3rd year internship, or within 12-months of graduation.
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like "How do we evaluate wildfire risk and optimize a power grid as a result" or "How do we quickly assess our food supply chain and modify it to deliver life saving assistance on time?" As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
This role is based in our New York City office and is open to students and recent graduates of the French Grandes Écoles.
 
Core Responsibilities 
 
As an FDSE Intern, your responsibilities look similar to those at a small startup, with the resources, stability and mentorship of an established tech company: You’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.
 
FDSE Interns are treated just like full time engineers, with significant freedom and ownership over their work. Interns take responsibility for real world projects and outcomes that our customers rely on.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Platform Intelligence Engineers are the engine behind Palantir’s most strategic and important operations. Engineers are responsible for designing, creating, and maintaining the critical data infrastructure layer that powers decision-making across the business. This infrastructure enables teams to understand product usage, stability trends, cost efficiency, value creation, revenue streams, and more.
 
As an Intelligence Engineer, you will partner with teammates and leaders across the business to address, measure, and evaluate Palantir’s internal strategic and tactical performance. You will keep business outcomes in mind as you develop data pipelines, perform analysis, and work with stakeholders to operationalize insights that propel the business forward.
 
Depending on which team you join, you might analyze cloud utilization, user metrics, stability KPIs, cost optimizations, or even model pricing changes all while ensuring best in class support for our partner teams.
 
You will use Palantir’s platforms, just as Palantir’s customers do, to clean and enrich troves of data from disparate sources, allowing you to unlock key insights, create visualizations and custom applications that help drive day-to-day outcomes. Teams across Palantir will consult with and rely on you to help guide planning and decision-making for a wide range of topics while balancing various sets of priorities and weighing costs.
 
About You
 
You are proficient in Python and have experience in a previous or current job writing code on a day-to-day basis. You understand the challenges of finding the right data to answer a problem, cleaning data, and then distilling findings to executive-level insights under extreme time pressure. You are a master data manipulator — able to design systems, implement pipelines, decomp existing codebases, and clearly present findings to leadership.
 
You are a problem solver who loves gathering information from various sources, analyzing and presenting your recommendations to technical teams, business partners, and Palantir leadership. You are a top-level communicator who thrives in both cross-timezone collaborations as well as individual projects. You feel comfortable working in a data-rich and dynamic environment, putting various pieces of the puzzle together to create a coherent picture.
 
This position will offer an exciting work environment, wide-ranging exposure, and a chance to create a measurable impact on Palantir’s operations, customer satisfaction and bottom line.
